schema_note: Enriched card merging the original retrodiction card + parameter audit + skeptic panel + repair-agent repairs and fertility scores. Repair status: repaired-with-narrowing (Class C, honest recovery downstream of an explicit SBT disclaimer).

card.one_sentence_claim: The kinetic-to-hydrodynamic (small-Knudsen) limit can be re-expressed as an SBT closure package -- moment lens + Maxwellian/max-entropy completion + timescale-tau evolution -- in which the TV idempotence defect delta_{tau,f} of the packaging map E_{tau,f} decreases as BGK collision strength omega rises, recovering the qualitative BGK/moment-closure content of hydrodynamic reduction and supplying a falsifiable failure-mode taxonomy (wrong equilibrium family; missing slow mode).
card.target_known_fact: In the hydrodynamic (small-Knudsen) limit, BGK relaxation drives a kinetic distribution toward a local Maxwellian; retaining low-order moments with a local-equilibrium completion yields a closed fluid description whose self-consistency improves as collision frequency rises (Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook 1954; Levermore 1996 max-entropy moment closure; Chapman-Enskog).
card.scientific_domain: Statistical mechanics / kinetic theory / hydrodynamics (low-Knudsen limit)
card.baseline_comparison: SBT does NOT do better than the standard account; it RECOVERS the qualitative content of the BGK / moment-closure / Chapman-Enskog reduction (closure quality controlled by a Knudsen-like parameter) and imports the standard kinetic theory (BGK relaxation, Maxwellian equilibrium, moment hierarchy) wholesale. It produces no continuum hydrodynamic equation, no Navier-Stokes derivation, and no transport coefficients -- all of which the standard Chapman-Enskog expansion does deliver. What SBT genuinely REORGANIZES is the meta-level: it casts moment-closure validity as a single auditable pass/fail certificate (the idempotence defect, dialed by omega) and adds a concrete, falsifiable failure-mode taxonomy (FM1 weak-collision/strong-gradient, FM2 wrong equilibrium family, FM3 missing slow mode).
card.why_scientists_care: It turns a familiar but somewhat informal modeling judgement -- 'is my moment closure valid in this regime?' -- into a single, reproducible, dialable certificate (the idempotence defect vs a Knudsen-like parameter) accompanied by an explicit, falsifiable taxonomy of the ways moment closures fail. For practitioners of kinetic/fluid model reduction, lattice-Boltzmann, and closure modeling, this is a reusable auditing discipline rather than new physics; for foundations-of-emergence it is a clean, controlled instance where 'objects = fixed points of an approximately idempotent completion' lines up with a textbook physical limit.
target_audience: Kinetic theory and rarefied-gas-dynamics researchers (BGK, Chapman-Enskog, moment-closure / Grad / Levermore hierarchies)
Computational fluid dynamics and lattice-Boltzmann practitioners doing model reduction and closure validation
Applied mathematicians working on multiscale coarse-graining and effective dynamics
Foundations-of-emergence / philosophy-of-physics researchers interested in inter-theory reduction as closure
card.recommended_artifact: A reproducible computational note (deterministic Python + the existing To_Become_a_Stone BGK artifacts) presenting: (i) the discrete-velocity BGK closure package, (ii) the delta_{tau,f}(omega) endpoint trend with null gate, (iii) the FM1-FM3 failure-mode tables, and (iv) one new contribution -- a finite-state monotonicity/contraction lemma attempting to upgrade the aggregate trend to a theorem (delta non-increasing in omega with an explicit bound). Framed explicitly as an auditable closure-coherence diagnostic for moment-closure validity, NOT as a derivation of hydrodynamics.
card.execution_cost: Low. The numerical demonstration already exists in To_Become_a_Stone (deterministic, seeded, with figures/tables); reproducing and re-presenting it is days of work. The one genuinely new piece -- a finite-state contraction lemma making delta(omega) provably non-increasing -- is moderate (weeks) and uses standard finite-Markov / discrete-simplex contraction tools. Any continuum-limit / Navier-Stokes recovery is high-cost and out of scope (disclaimed).
card.honest_status_note: Class C, honestly downstream of a disclaimer. The BGK kinetic->hydrodynamic result is a NUMERICAL certificate (deterministic Python), not a theorem and not Lean-certified; the Lean backbone covers only the abstract uniform-fiber calculus (section_uniform, E_idempotent_uniform, commutes_of_factorsThrough, TV_Q_f_le), explicitly NOT the BGK/Maxwellian example (paper line 923). All standard kinetic theory (BGK relaxation, Maxwellian/max-entropy equilibrium, moment closure) is imported; SBT contributes a relabeling plus a diagnostic auditing layer. The paper explicitly disclaims deriving continuum theories ('not Navier-Stokes', line 787); there is NO continuum interface and NO convergence theorem in SBT. The completion U_f (Maxwellian) is chosen by hand with no canonical-selection rule (a named missing interface). The minimum-viable result is fully grounded and reproducible today; the stronger (monotonicity theorem) result is plausible; a true limit/derivation result is out of scope and disclaimed. No claim crosses an SBT disclaimer as stated.

NOTE: the omega=1 defect is still LARGE (0.285 on an ~[0,0.5] TV scale); the card's 'recovers hydrodynamic closure' framing overstates this and was narrowed in repair (the defect is REDUCED, not driven near zero).

opposite_world_test.explanation: Mostly yes, with one structural caveat. The headline is only a qualitative aggregate trend and the paper concedes intermediate omega need not be monotone, so by tuning the hand-selected completion U_f, transport/collision weighting, tau, and the L1/TV normalization, SBT could surface a flat or locally-increasing defect curve and narrate it as FM1 (weak-collision regime, delta 0.486). The failure-mode taxonomy is elastic enough to absorb an opposite or null trend as 'a regime where the chosen layer is not the right object.' The single robust direction-pin is omega=1, where the imported BGK step literally projects onto the equilibrium manifold E_f reconstructs, making small(er) defect near-tautological -- but that pin comes from imported kinetic theory, not SBT.

audit.audit_verdict: RECOVERY-WITH-MEDIUM-FLEXIBILITY (honest Class C, downstream of a disclaimer). ~9 explicit knobs + ~5 implicit imports against ~4 qualitative data points; medium overfitting risk. The completion U_f is the named MISSING interface (no canonical-selection rule -- this IS FM2), and the FM3 collapse to 1.84e-17 is engineered by adding back the very mode known to be missing. NO new physics. NOT a theorem, NOT Lean-certified. No continuum interface, no convergence theorem, no Navier-Stokes, no transport coefficients -- all explicitly DISCLAIMED. Mechanism reuse is genuine (idempotent-packaging P5 + route-mismatch P3 = same machinery as R001 dephasing, R009 LES). No claim as stated crosses an SBT disclaimer.

consensus_objections: The idempotence defect delta is a fixed-point saturation diagnostic, NOT the dissipative/relaxational quantity (H-theorem, relative-entropy decay) that is the actual physics of the small-Knudsen limit; the H-theorem and Chapman-Enskog transport coefficients are not recovered even qualitatively.

The omega-down-as-defect direction is structurally pre-loaded by the imported BGK contraction f<-(1-omega)f+omega f_eq; at omega=1 the collision step IS projection onto the manifold U_f completes to, so the only sign-pinned endpoint tests imported kinetic theory, not SBT.

The verified omega=1 defect is still LARGE (0.285), so 'hydrodynamic closure becomes self-consistent' is overstated; only a ~31% relative reduction with admittedly non-monotone interior is shown, and there is no monotonicity theorem.

FM3's collapse 0.262 -> 1.84e-17 is the trivial identity 'adding the omitted variable removes the omission error', reverse-engineered from the known answer; it is a consistency check, not a prediction.
DoF imbalance: ~9 knobs + ~5 imports vs ~4 qualitative data points, zero sig-figs of external empirical constraint (no transport coefficient produced or compared).
skeptic_panel.convergent_repair: All four skeptics agree the single most valuable upgrade is a finite-state Dobrushin/Banach contraction THEOREM proving delta_{tau,f}(omega) non-increasing in omega with an explicit bound delta <= C(omega,tau), ideally with the omega-dependence DERIVED from the packaging structure rather than re-reading the BGK contraction rate, plus a demonstration that the route-mismatch residual reproduces the leading Chapman-Enskog correction term. Short of that, the deliverable must be framed strictly as recovery/reorganization with delta always paired to the u_err/e_err audits per the saturation guardrail.
skeptic_panel.what_would_change_minds: A proved finite-state contraction theorem (delta non-increasing in omega, explicit bound -> 0 as omega -> 1) PLUS evidence the defect carries information beyond the tautological omega=1 projection -- e.g. an intermediate-omega regime where delta correlates with an independently computed closure deficit CD_tau or a Chapman-Enskog residual order. Either would move this from 'relabeling of imported physics' toward 'genuine non-tautological finite-state reorganization'.

repair.repair_philosophy: Only allowed repairs applied: narrowed the claim, replaced 'recovers hydrodynamic closure' with the honest magnitude (defect REDUCED, not eliminated; 0.285 is still large), demoted FM3 from prediction to consistency-check identity, attributed the omega=1 endpoint sign to imported BGK structure, converted the qualitative trend into a stated aggregate-endpoint comparison with the monotonicity theorem flagged as not-yet-proved, and mandated pairing delta with u_err/e_err per the saturation guardrail. No arbitrary assumptions added, no imported physics hidden, no unproven uniqueness asserted.
repair.revised_one_sentence_claim: In a discrete-velocity BGK model, the kinetic-to-hydrodynamic reduction can be RE-EXPRESSED (not derived) as an SBT closure package -- moment lens Q_f + hand-selected Maxwellian/max-entropy completion U_f + timescale-tau packaging E_{tau,f} -- whose TV idempotence defect delta_{tau,f}, paired with macro-field audits (u_err, e_err), is REDUCED (0.418->0.285 at tau=10, an aggregate endpoint trend, not driven to zero) as collision strength omega rises, with the omega=1 endpoint sign inherited from the imported BGK projection; the genuinely SBT-side contribution is the closure-coherence-as-certificate framing plus a falsifiable failure-mode taxonomy (FM1 weak-collision/strong-gradient delta=0.486; FM2 wrong equilibrium family u_err=0.347; FM3 missing energy slow mode e_err=0.262, collapsing to ~1.8e-17 as the trivial identity of adding back the omitted mode).
repair.new_minimum_viable_result: A reproducible, deterministic (seed=0, 200-trial) numerical certificate that in the discrete-velocity BGK model (N_x=16, N_v=3, V={-1,0,1}) the SBT idempotence defect of the moment-lens + max-entropy-completion packaging map is reduced in aggregate as omega rises (0.418->0.285 at tau=10; 0.423->0.399 at tau=2; 0.419->0.348 at tau=5), with the omega=0 null gate, the defect remaining large even at omega=1, delta always reported alongside u_err/e_err, and the FM1-FM3 failure taxonomy framed as a diagnostic checklist -- i.e. the kinetic->hydrodynamic limit RE-EXPRESSED as an auditable closure-coherence diagnostic atop standard BGK/moment-closure theory, recovering (not deriving) the qualitative content. This already exists in To_Become_a_Stone (Tab:bgk-endpoints, Tab:bgk-failure-modes).

remaining_objections: The result remains a relabeling of imported BGK/moment-closure physics; the H-theorem, Chapman-Enskog gradient expansion, and transport coefficients (viscosity, thermal conductivity) are NOT recovered even qualitatively.
The omega=1 endpoint is near-tautological (BGK at omega=1 IS the projection E_f completes to), so the only sign-pinned datum is imported kinetic theory.
The defect stays large (0.285) at the most favorable endpoint; the framework demonstrates a relative trend, not an approach-to-idempotence / closed-object.
No monotonicity theorem exists (aggregate, non-strict, error-bar-free endpoint comparison at selected tau); the contraction lemma is acknowledged as not in the papers.

Medium overfitting risk: ~9 knobs + ~5 imports vs ~4 qualitative data points, zero external empirical constraint; the FM taxonomy is a post-hoc-flexible classifier rather than a pre-registered risky prediction.
BGK example is a Python-only numerical certificate, NOT Lean-certified; the Lean backbone anchors only the abstract uniform-fiber calculus.
repair.forbidden_repairs_avoided: Did not add a continuum-limit interface, did not assert a canonical U_f selection rule, did not claim the monotonicity theorem as proved, did not hide the imported BGK/Maxwellian physics, did not upgrade FM3 to a genuine prediction, did not claim Lean certification of the BGK numbers.

score_rationale.impact: 2 - For practitioners it offers a reusable closure-audit discipline and a clean foundations-of-emergence worked example, but it produces no new physics, no transport coefficients, and recovers only qualitative textbook content; impact is confined to a methodological/pedagogical reframing.
score_rationale.execution_ease: 5 - Already executed: deterministic, seeded Python with figures/tables verified in the source. Reproduction is days; the one new lemma is weeks of standard finite-Markov work.
score_rationale.plausibility: 5 - Every quoted number is verified against the paper; the qualitative match to BGK/Chapman-Enskog is real and uncontested; nothing claimed is physically wrong.
score_rationale.non_ad_hocness: 3 - The core mechanism (idempotent packaging + route mismatch) is genuinely reused across R001/R009 and is not a per-fact patch, but the hand-selected U_f (named missing interface) and the target-shaped FM3 lens extension carry real ad-hoc pressure; honestly flagged, so not lower.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 1 - Opposite-world test passes: a flat or opposite trend would be re-narrated as FM1 'wrong-layer regime'; the only sign-pinned endpoint is forced by imported BGK structure, not by SBT. The FM taxonomy is an elastic classifier, not a risky prediction.
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 4 - The lens/completion/defect framing and the FM1-FM3 checklist are clear and directly legible to kinetic-theory and CFD/lattice-Boltzmann practitioners; the honest recovery-not-derivation framing aids legibility.
score_rationale.precision: 1 - Qualitative trend + failure-mode sign/ordering only; zero significant figures of external empirical constraint (no transport coefficient produced or compared). The quoted defects are outputs of a chosen TV metric on a 16x3 toy. SBT disclaimers cap this hard.
score_rationale.robustness: 3 - The endpoint sign survives because it is pinned by imported BGK dynamics; the qualitative trend and the FM taxonomy survive removing flexible assumptions, but the quantitative 'self-consistency' reading does not (defect stays 0.285), and intermediate omega is admittedly non-monotone.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 1 - Explicitly does NOT beat the standard account; the card's own baseline_comparison concedes it RECOVERS and imports wholesale. Standard Chapman-Enskog delivers transport coefficients and a continuum equation that SBT cannot. Disclaimers cap this.
score_rationale.publication_potential: 2 - As a standalone the BGK numerics are too thin and recovery-only for a physics venue; it has a home as one instantiation in the existing To_Become_a_Stone framework paper or a foundations-of-emergence / model-reduction methods note. The proposed contraction lemma, if proved, would raise this.

triage.recommended_artifact: A reproducible computational note presenting the discrete-velocity BGK closure package, the delta(omega,tau) endpoint table with the omega=0 null gate, the FM1-FM3 failure-mode tables (with delta always paired to u_err/e_err), and -- as the one genuinely new piece -- an attempted finite-state Dobrushin/Banach contraction lemma upgrading the aggregate trend toward a theorem. Framed strictly as an auditable closure-coherence diagnostic for moment-closure validity, NOT a derivation of hydrodynamics.
triage.one_line_verdict: Honest Class-C recovery: the kinetic->hydrodynamic limit relabeled as an approximately-idempotent closure package whose defect is reduced (not eliminated) as collisions dominate; no new physics, sign-pinned by imported BGK, but a clean reusable closure-audit + failure-mode checklist -- a conceptual reframing worth keeping, not a flagship.
